name: FedEx Freight Holding Company, Inc.
summary: FedEx Freight Holding Company, Inc. provides less-than-truckload freight transportation services in the United States and internationally. The company offers FedEx Freight Priority services, including next-business-day service for shipments traveling up to 600 miles and second-business-day service for shipments traveling up to 1,600 miles and backed by a money-back service guarantee if published delivery commitments are not met; and FedEx Freight Economy. It also provides surface expedite and white glove services; and LTL Select, a cloud-based transportation management system.
